Scion page lists Ascendant, Reliquarian, and Luminary
Luminary page describes permanent Mercenary gearing

coverage_lens.non_goal: This is not a meta tier list and does not mark any build solved before launch data and PoB updates.

facts: Curse of the Allflame uses Charts found across Wraeclast to board The Sovereign and explore the ocean floor.
Lanterns imbued with the Allflame protect the player during ocean-floor exploration.
Completed charting can be connected into a Voyage, revisiting chart rewards and amplifying them.
The ship heart can split an input item into multiple ghostly outcomes, one of which can be kept.
Ducats found on the seafloor are used to warp and twist items in new ways.
PoEWiki Chart and Ducat pages already expose Allflame terms such as Chart, Voyage, Deepwater, Ducats, and Allflame crafting.
poe_wide_implications: Early league strategy should measure Chart acquisition rate, Voyage time per reward, and danger level before calling it a primary farm.
The item-splitting/ghostly-outcome loop and Ducats create a new crafting/economy layer that can affect rare item planning.
Builds with stable recovery, mobility, and low setup time should be safer first testers for ocean-floor content.

facts: Scion must be treated as three-way branching: Ascendant, Reliquarian, and Luminary.
Reliquarian is a Scion ascendancy whose major nodes integrate effects from unique items and change by league.
Luminary is a Scion ascendancy that permanently hires and gears Mercenaries.
3.29 introduces two new Bloodline Classes, one exclusive to Curse of the Allflame.
Bloodline ascendancy classes are secondary ascendancies that can be taken alongside a character's usual ascendancy and share ascendancy passive points.
poe_wide_implications: Scion analysis cannot be collapsed into one recommendation. Ascendant, Reliquarian, and Luminary need separate tree, item, and role models.
Bloodline systems introduce opportunity cost against regular ascendancy points, so build power must include point pressure.
Reliquarian is item-effect research; Luminary is ally/equipment-state research. Mixing them without a live PoB is a modeling error.

facts: Mercenaries of Trarthus are core in 3.29.
A Mercenary does not count as a player party member for monster life or item quantity/rarity scaling.
Luminary can permanently hire up to 3 Mercenaries, with 2 in reserve and 1 active combat ally.
Luminary can change the items equipped by permanently hired Mercenaries.
Trarthan Gems return to Mercenary encounters rather than Heist Gem Chests.
Mercenary-exclusive uniques are again obtained through Mercenary encounters and removed from the core drop pool.
Mercenaries receive Atlas passive support and a series of Trarthan Scarabs.
poe_wide_implications: The build model needs a separate Mercenary state: active ally, two reserves, gear, role, and survivability.
Mercenary farming becomes its own Atlas/scarab branch, not just a Scion feature.
Trade economy for Trarthan Gems, Mercenary-exclusive uniques, and Trarthan Scarabs should be tracked after launch.

facts: Pact of Beidat empowers projectile, targeted-area, or chaining-beam spells while applying an Affliction.
Pact of Ghorr empowers damage-over-time spells, applies an Affliction, and grants Hunger of Ghorr/Fleshrend behavior.
Pact of K'tash empowers damaging Vaal spells, applies an Affliction, reduces soul gain prevention, and refunds souls on use.
Pact of Lycia empowers self-cast channelling spells, applies an Affliction, and triggers lightning bolts while channelling.
Coursing Currents is an Exceptional Support for hit skills that links chill and shock behavior.
Crystalfall is an Exceptional Support that triggers Falling Crystal on hit and supports Slam skills, but cannot support triggered skills or skills used by things other than you.
New or transfigured skills include Mana-Infused Staff, Divine Blast of Radiance, Holy Hammers of Spirals, Holy Sweep of Hammerfalls, and Reap of Butchery.
poe_wide_implications: DoT spell, channelling, Vaal spell, slam, staff/block, spell crit, and strength/int archetypes need retesting.
Blight of Contagion is a retest candidate because it intersects DoT and channelling lenses, but it is not a solved recommendation.
Crystalfall creates a strict self-used slam lane because it excludes triggered or non-player-used skills.

facts: Gems can now be socketed into any equipment socket even when gem colour does not match socket colour.
Socketed gems gain +10% quality in red, green, and blue sockets if the gem colour matches the socket colour.
Item sockets are white by default, with non-white socket chances scaling by item level and attribute requirements.
Chromatic Orbs and Tainted Chromatic Orbs now force one socket to be non-white while the rest roll normally.
Currency that adds sockets creates added sockets as white.
Chromatic Orbs are rarer and are no longer sold by vendors for Jeweller's Orbs.
Bench colour crafts changed to non-white socket count crafts.
poe_wide_implications: Gem colour friction is lower, but non-white matching colour becomes an optimization and economy problem.
Loot filters and crafting advice need to distinguish white-socket baseline from valuable non-white socket setups.
Old advice about off-colouring gear and Chromatic Orb availability needs revision.

facts: Mercenaries of Trarthus receive Atlas passive and Trarthan Scarab support.
A new Altered Prophecy cluster can make Tier 14+ Maps drop Scrying Orbs.
Scrying Orbs store the source map and allow the Divination Cards of that map area to be scried to another Atlas map.
Legion splinter rewards are concentrated: Legion Generals drop more splinters, while non-Sergeant, non-General Legion monsters no longer drop Timeless Splinters.
Sergeants and Chests have lower splinter drop chance but higher stack sizes.
poe_wide_implications: Atlas strategy must be refreshed for Mercenary, Scrying Orb, and Legion reward-source changes.
Legion farming should be evaluated around Generals/Sergeants/Chests rather than generic monster-clearing assumptions.
Scrying Orb introduces map/divination-card routing decisions that need live economy data.

facts: Allflame adds Ducats and Allflame crafting terms to the economy.
The league loop includes item transformation through the ship heart and ghostly outcomes.
Mercenary encounters regain Trarthan Gems and Mercenary-exclusive uniques.
Trarthan Scarabs directly modify Mercenary encounter access and reward shape.
Chromatic Orb scarcity and socket colour changes affect early gear setup costs.
Legion Timeless Splinter source changes alter expected reward distribution.
poe_wide_implications: Launch-week tracking should record price/time for Ducats, Charts, Trarthan Scarabs, Trarthan Gems, Scrying Orbs, Chromatics, and Legion splinters.
Do not recommend high-invest farming before measuring map time, failure rate, and sellable outputs.
SSF advice should emphasize access routes, not trade prices.

build_archetype_impact_lens.risk: Affliction cost and channeling safety unknown until live/PoB data.
Soul gain prevention and soul refund behavior must be tested per skill.
Crystalfall excludes triggered/non-player-used skills; weapon and speed scaling constraints matter.
Needs itemization and actual defensive recovery checks.
Mercenary AI, survivability, equipment restrictions, and role value need live testing.
Must remain separate from Luminary; each unique-effect branch needs its own PoB validation.

likely_friction_points: Scion now has multiple branches and can be misunderstood as one generic recommendation.
Bloodline ascendancies share ascendancy passive points, so users may over-allocate or compare them like free bonuses.
White sockets reduce colour restriction but non-white sockets still matter for quality and economy.
Mercenary gear/skills are separate build state and should not be flattened into player gem links.
Allflame Chart/Voyage/Ducat terminology creates a new reward loop that beginners will not map to old Atlas habits.
pathcraft_required_output: Ask which Scion branch is selected before recommending a Scion build.
Show player links and Mercenary setup separately.
Explain socket colour changes as lower access friction plus new non-white optimization.
Use early/mid/late farming gates based on measured map time, death rate, and reward output.

unresolved_lens.rule: Patch notes and wiki pages are available, but launch economy, encounter risk, and drop rates are not measured yet.
New gems, Bloodline classes, Mercenary details, Allflame items, and passive updates require a fresh 3.29 GGPK extraction.
No build should be promoted from watchlist to recommendation without PoB support for the relevant 3.29 mechanics.
PoEWiki page bodies are updated, but some category/API index views can lag; prefer page-body revision evidence for Scion/Luminary verification.

coach_rules: Use this file as a whole-patch context map, not as a build tier list.
For Scion, always branch into Ascendant, Reliquarian, or Luminary before giving build advice.
Keep Mercenary setup separate from player skill links.
Treat Allflame Chart/Voyage/Ducat farming as uncalibrated until live reward/time data exists.
Do not call Blight of Contagion, Reap of Butchery, Pact of Ghorr, or Pact of Lycia solved before PoB and live data.
